Verify ocr() method exists in all bindings

```php title="PHP"
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';

use Liter\Llm\LiterLlm;
use Liter\Llm\OcrRequest;
$req = \Liter\Llm\OcrRequest::from_json(json_encode(["document" => ["type" => "document_url", "url" => "https://example.com/contract-test.pdf"], "model" => "mistral/mistral-ocr-latest"]));
$apiKey = getenv('API_KEY');
if ($apiKey === false || $apiKey === '') {
    throw new RuntimeException('API_KEY must be set');
}
$client = LiterLlm::createClient($apiKey);
$result = $client->ocr($req);
var_dump($result);
```
